# Frozen MultiNLI 1.0 next-vote protocol

Decision recorded before reading mismatched rows. Use the official author archive (SHA-256 049f507b9e36b1fcb756cfd5aeb3b7a0cfcb84bf023793652987f7e7e0957822). Matched development fits all parameters. Mismatched development is the sole test, with previously unseen genres. Official challenge test labels are private. Retain exactly five valid labels, including disputed items. Exclude test prompts or normalized premises occurring in development. Pool prompt IDs sharing normalized premises into connected components for resampling. Only the four-vote class counts are predictors. Never use pair-ID suffix, text, genre, gold label, vote order, identities, or held vote for inference.

Target a uniformly chosen recorded vote conditional on the other four. Enumerate all five leave-one-position-out evaluations per item. Score multiclass Brier (sum of squared errors), average per item then across items. Zeros are legitimate forecasts. Single candidate: six-component empirical Bayes mixture of categorical vote propensities, using four counts to update posterior component weights. Fit on five-count development histograms with multinomial-mixture EM, 20 deterministic initializations, 500 iterations maximum, pseudocount 0.5 per class/component and per mixture weight; retain the highest penalized development likelihood. Six components permit more latent disagreement patterns than the three target classes. K is fixed, never selected on the test set.

Comparators: raw frequencies; equal-mass tied majority; Jeffreys add-half; Laplace add-one; one development-fitted Dirichlet-multinomial prior; three-class latent-class EM with a shared confusion matrix across anonymous voters (exchangeable Dawid–Skene restriction; same optimizer); and a saturated conditional four-count table of development held votes pooled over all five positions. For the table choose backoff strength in {0,1,5,25,125,625} by grouped five-fold development Brier to a fold-local fitted Dirichlet prediction, choosing smaller strength on ties. Unseen cells back off completely.

Require a strictly positive lower bound for **every** baseline-minus-candidate difference. Paired bootstrap 10,000 times at the connected prompt/premise-group level (seed 41021), preserving item weighting; report Bonferroni two-sided familywise 95% percentile intervals over seven comparisons. These quantify item-sampling uncertainty conditional on the observed genres and fitted models. Report every null and loss. No second test choice, candidate revision, or author-specific agreement claim. Retain full scores and sufficient prediction tables for replay.
